fusions.name: Blood-Scent Strike
fusions.desc: Dives on an afflicted enemy for 9 damage and uses up one of your afflictions on it. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. It needs an affliction on the target.

fusions.name: Wake Chase
fusions.desc: Glides up to 7 tiles onto the target and strikes for 14 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Frenzy Window
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent on the Wind
fusions.desc: When you afflict something, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for the next 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
